skill.summary: Convert persona docs into detailed feature specifications with acceptance criteria. Use when translating user needs into implementable specs, writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, or preparing features for development.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the feature-specification skill.
- Converts persona documentation into detailed, actionable feature specifications.
- Provides a clear template for feature specs including user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and scope.
- Offers guidance on writing strong user stories and acceptance test patterns.
- Introduces prioritization (MoSCoW) and highlights common specification anti-patterns.
